note: Forbidden: authenticating a cache by its Common Name. Negative TestRTRTLSRejectsUnauthenticatedCaches "CN only" issues a server certificate whose CN matches the reference and has no DNS SAN, and assertRTRTLSRefused asserts it is refused, so a CN fallback goes red. Positive TestRTRTLSAuthenticatedCache: a certificate whose CN differs from the reference but whose DNS-ID matches authenticates, so a CN check that overrode DNS-ID goes red.
